# Precision of the binds resources against HuRI (generated by experiments/measure_binds_resource_precision.py)

Generated by `experiments/measure_binds_resource_precision.py` on 2026-10-22 at commit ba7573e-dirty from data/processed/graph_full_v04/edge_evidence.parquet, data/raw/omnipath/omnipath_interactions.tsv, data/raw/huri/HuRI.tsv, data/raw/huri/Lit-BM.tsv, data/raw/hgnc/hgnc_complete_set.txt; do not edit by hand.

Graph `data/processed/graph_full_v04` (edges.parquet sha256 first 16 ae59ed71f3f72256). Decision 9.91's measurement, a report that sets no weight. Method (Venkatesan et al. 2009): a resource's detection rate in HuRI's tested space placed between that of Lit-BM (a positive reference set) and that of a random pair of tested proteins, precision = (f - f_random) / (f_Lit-BM - f_random). The tested space is the 8,236 genes with at least one HuRI interaction (Space III's list could not be read). HuRI and Lit-BM are not scored: OmniPath imports both, and no resource is credited with a pair it cites only from a CCSB screen paper. A low value can mean co-complex, ligand-receptor or modification-dependent pairs that a yeast two-hybrid screen cannot detect, not only error.
